name: Create Member V 01
definition: Scope|The ModifyMember message is sent by a member to the transaction administrator.|It is used to create the profile of a member that the transaction administrator maintains.|Usage|Based on the criteria defined in the CreateLimit message, the transaction administrator will execute or reject the requested creation and respond with a Receipt message as a reply to the request.
